en: An old, worn map-style postcard printed in French, showing the department of Pyrénées-Orientales in southern France. The map is bordered in red and displays roads, towns, railways, and relief shading. A prominent inset map in the upper left details the city of Perpignan. French labels, a legend, and postal-related information are printed around the map. The paper shows fold marks, stains, and aging typical of an early 20th‑century card.
